The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] trailblazer [[Gan Basso]] owned a '''starship''' in the early [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[25,053 BBY]]. Basso used the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to discover many new [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] for the Republic, but a hasty jump to hyperspace led to the ship's destruction and Basso's [[Death/Legends|death]] when the vessel collided with the [[Datar system's sun|sun]] of the [[Datar system/Legends|Datar system]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gan Basso and his starship were first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
